theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_bwd_coordinate_form
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → ∃ ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m, IsSmoothForm ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport a ∧ ∀ x : Euclid (m + 1), exteriorDerivative ψ x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
